reason: Clear external target-validity gap: NL requires decryption semantics, while the formal target only constrains output length.
nl_requirement: Decrypt Right-Left cipher text back to the original plaintext.
formal_spec_gap: Method postcondition enforces only |result| == |t| and omits any content/semantic relation to ciphertext.
weak_spec_proxy_description: Adapted spec check verifies only output length equality with input.
intended_oracle_description: Construct encrypted strings from known plaintext samples and require exact plaintext recovery.
reviewer_notes: This is an adapted minimal demonstration, not a claim that the external benchmark is a bug or vulnerability.
